datasets.title: Combined monthly territory changes
datasets.description: Uses the dashboard Combined algorithm: exact previous calendar month-end opening (23 February for February 2022), latest usable closing from the same source, later coverage preferred, DeepState wins ties. Alternate-source replacement covers the entire interval. No subtraction of DS and NZZ absolute areas, interpolation, or bridging missing months. Partial intervals retain their actual end date; missing data is null, not zero. Mixed-source sums are estimates, not a single-source occupied-area total. Source revisions may affect changes.
